Data analyst with 8 years of experience in quantitative research and 6 in SaaS product companies (Zendesk, Brainly). Currently working as Senior Business Data Analyst in Profitroom where I work with all stakeholder levels on making data-driven decisions and set up processes around data.

Mentor in three editions of TechLeaders and experienced public speaker. I will walk you through the valley of data from basics of data engineering through data preparation and analysis to reporting and visualization. I fear not of experimentation and statistics. Favourite breakfast: hypoteses.
